What Teams Say About Us
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Aislelabs gave OAK an entirely new level of data on how our Oklahoma City Thunder Watch Parties drove measurable increases in sales and traffic across the project. The real-time insights into visitor lift, dwell times, and guest movement allowed OAK to clearly quantify attendance and understand where guests spent time across the property both before and after the events.
 
These insights allowed OAK to directly connect traffic patterns to tenant sales and overall property performance, giving us clear, data-backed proof of the impact these events generated. It has become an essential tool in how we plan, measure success, and understand guest behavior. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Aislelabs Flow gives us valuable insights into shopper traffic patterns and zone‑level movement across the centre. It’s intuitive to use, secure, and helps our team make data‑driven decisions to support marketing, leasing, and overall mall performance. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Aislelabs seamlessly supports our team's e-mail marketing strategy. We are able to capture guest data more efficiently, grow our customer database and target audiences with high-performing campaigns that drive engagement, sales and revenue. Equally impressive is that we capture on-site foot traffic data during critical mass events to help us leverage decision making and value proposition to external partners. Aislelabs give us marketing tools and the operational insights we need to grow our business strategically. It's become an essential tool to how we operate and promote our business. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Great Experience with Aislelabs with Smooth Implementation and Integration and lovely team. Their platform gives us valuable visitor analytics, heat maps, and insights that support smarter leasing and marketing decisions. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 The Amazing Brentwood team continues to value our partnership with Aislelabs. Their collaborative approach and deep technical expertise create a seamless experience, supported by a clear understanding of our evolving needs. Together, we’ve built a strong working relationship that consistently delivers meaningful results and enhances our overall operations.

Pricing
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Aislelabs Pricing | WiFi Marketing & Location Analytics Packages
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Pricing & Packaging
 
Pricing built around your physical location goals
 
 Compare Aislelabs solutions for guest WiFi, customer capture, WiFi marketing, captive portal engagement, and location analytics built for physical venues.
 
 
 
 
 
Built for physical venues
 Supporting museums, healthcare, events, restaurants, hospitality, mixed-use environments, airports, and shopping centres.
 
 
 
Designed for multiple teams
 Helping marketing teams, operations leaders, IT leads, leasing teams, and business owners work from a stronger, shared view of visitor behaviour.
 
 
 
Focused on measurable value
 From customer capture to engagement and visitor analytics, every package is built to support real business outcomes.
 
 
 
 
How to choose
 
Choose the right pricing package for your physical location strategy
 
 Aislelabs pricing is built around the outcomes you want to drive across your physical locations. Whether your priority is understanding visitor behaviour through location analytics, turning guest WiFi into a first-party data channel, or activating WiFi marketing campaigns tied to real-world visits, we’ll help you choose the right package for your environment, scale, and goals.
 
 
 Most customers choose a package based on one of three priorities:
 
 
 
 
Visitor analytics
 
Choose this path if your priority is understanding foot traffic, dwell time, heat maps, zone performance, and visitor patterns across one or more properties.
 
 
 
WiFi Marketing
 
Choose this path if you want to turn guest WiFi and captive portal login into a branded, consent-based channel for customer capture, growth, and ongoing engagement.
 
 
 
Full platform value
 
Choose this path if you want to connect analytics, customer capture, and campaign activation to improve engagement, loyalty, and measurable business outcomes.
 
 
 
 
 
Bundle options
 
Choose a bundled package
 
 Bundles bring together complementary Aislelabs capabilities for teams that want broader value from day one. Start with a focused bundle or choose the full platform for the strongest cross-functional view across WiFi marketing and location analytics.
 
 
 
 
 
Bundle option
 
Aislelabs Growth Bundle
 
Connect + Marketing
 
 Combine guest WiFi customer capture with activation workflows in one package. Ideal for organizations that want to grow first-party data, build direct relationships, and turn captured audiences into measurable engagement opportunities.
 
 
 
Branded guest WiFi login and consent-based customer capture
 
Email, social, and CRM integration support
 
Audience segmentation and triggered campaign workflows
 
Review, loyalty, and re-engagement activation tools
 
 
 A strong option for teams focused on customer acquisition, engagement, and ongoing WiFi marketing activation.
 
 
Request Pricing
 
 
 
Bundle option
 
Aislelabs Insight Bundle
 
Flow + Connect
 
 Combine visitor analytics with guest WiFi customer capture in one package. Ideal for organizations that want a stronger view of how visitors move through their locations while also building a first-party data foundation.
 
 
 
Foot traffic, dwell, heat maps, and zone performance insight
 
Visitor segmentation and trend visibility
 
Branded guest WiFi login and consent-based identity capture
 
Better alignment between analytics and customer growth
 
 
 A strong option for teams that want to connect venue insight with customer capture and engagement readiness.
 
 
Request Pricing
 
 
 
Recommended
 
Platform bundle
 
Aislelabs Platform Suite
 
Flow + Connect + Marketing
 
 Bring together Flow, Connect, and Marketing in one connected platform. This is the best fit for organizations that want the strongest combination of visitor analytics, first-party customer capture, campaign activation, and cross-functional measurement.
 
 
 
Visitor analytics, customer capture, and campaign activation in one package
 
Full-funnel measurement across physical visits and engagement workflows
 
Cross-functional visibility for marketing, leasing, operations, and IT teams
 
Best fit for organizations looking for the broadest platform value
 
 
 Best for organizations that want the most complete Aislelabs package from day one.
 
 
Get a bundle quote
 
 
 
 
 
How to decide
 
Bundles vs. individual products
 
 Most teams that start with a standalone product end up adding more capabilities within 12 months. Bundles help you get there faster, with better cross-team alignment and better pricing from the start.
 
 
 
 
 
Start with a standalone product only if...
 
 A standalone product makes sense when you have a very narrow immediate need and a clear reason to keep your rollout limited for now. It can be the right first step, but it is usually a compromise rather than the highest-value path.
 
 
 
You are solving for one highly specific priority today
 
You need the smallest possible initial scope
 
You are comfortable adding more products later as needs expand
 
 
 
 
Choose a bundle if...
 
 If you have more than one team using location data, a bundle will almost always deliver more value. Bundles connect analytics, customer capture, and activation so teams can move faster with fewer gaps between insight and action.
 
 
 
You want stronger value than buying products separately over time
 
You need connected workflows across marketing, leasing, operations, or IT
 
You want analytics and engagement to work together from day one
 
 
 
 
 
 
Individual products
 
Start with a standalone solution
 
 Prefer to begin with one focused capability? These standalone products are designed for teams with a clear starting point and the flexibility to expand later.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Aislelabs Flow
 
Location analytics
 
 Turn visitor movement into actionable insight with location analytics and foot traffic analytics built for physical venues.
 
 
 
Foot traffic and dwell analysis
 
Heat maps
 
Zone performance analysis
 
Traffic trends analysis
 
 
Speak with an Expert

Guest WiFi and customer capture
 
 Transform guest WiFi and captive portal login into a first-party data and engagement channel through branded, consent-based experiences.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
How is Aislelabs priced?
 
 
Pricing depends on factors such as venue type, number of access points, number of locations, deployment scale, required modules, integrations, and support needs. Our team helps scope the right package based on your business goals and environment.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Can I start with one product and expand later?
 
 
Yes. Many organizations begin with one solution, such as guest WiFi engagement or location analytics, and expand over time as their measurement and activation needs grow..
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Do you support multi-location and enterprise deployments?
 
 
Yes. Aislelabs is built for organizations operating across one or many physical locations, with platform options that support consistent reporting, customer capture, and scalability across broader portfolios.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Which solution is right for my organization?
 
 
That depends on whether your priority is visitor analytics, guest WiFi-based customer capture, campaign activation, or a combination of all three. We can help recommend the best starting point based on your goals, venue type, and internal teams.
